scope: Direct visual review of selected actual-game PNGs. Full captures contain game artwork and remain local. Only relative filenames and hashes are recorded here; not every screen/frame/content item was manually inspected. Shore masks can clip reflections in the same way as native sprites; death/blinking can intentionally hide the body.
